CONTRACT DEFINITION:

2. INPUT: TypeScript configuration and src/types directory.
3. LOGIC: Create src/types/form.ts. Export interface FormProps<T = unknown> with onSubmit callback (value: T) => void, onCancel callback () => void, optional onError callback (error: unknown) => void.
4. OUTPUT: FormProps<T> interface defining the contract all forms must accept.

subtasks.title: Define DeferredPromise<T> interface
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - DeferredPromise<T> with promise: Promise<T | undefined>, resolve: (value: T | undefined) => void, reject: (reason?: unknown) => void. Key pattern for async openForm API.
2. INPUT: FormProps interface from P1.M2.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In src/types/form.ts, export interface DeferredPromise<T> containing promise property of type Promise<T | undefined>, resolve method (value: T | undefined) => void, reject method (reason?: unknown) => void.
4. OUTPUT: DeferredPromise<T> interface enabling externally-controlled promise resolution.

subtasks.title: Define StackEntry and OpenFormOptions interfaces
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - StackEntry (public: id, label), InternalStackEntry<T> (adds component, confirmOnCancel, deferred), OpenFormOptions<T> (id, component, label?, confirmOnCancel?).
2. INPUT: DeferredPromise interface from P1.M2.T1.S2.
3. LOGIC: Create src/types/stack.ts. Export interface StackEntry with id: string, optional label: string. Export interface OpenFormOptions<T> with id: string, component: ComponentType<FormProps<T>>, optional label: string, optional confirmOnCancel: boolean. Export interface InternalStackEntry<T = unknown> extending StackEntry with component: ComponentType<FormProps<T>>, confirmOnCancel: boolean, deferred: DeferredPromise<T>.
4. OUTPUT: Complete type definitions for stack management and form opening options.

tasks.title: Define Context Types
tasks.description: Create TypeScript types for the dual-context pattern (state context and actions context).

subtasks.title: Define FormStackState and FormStackActions interfaces
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Dual Context Pattern: separate state context (low-frequency updates) from actions context (high-frequency updates) to minimize re-renders.
2. INPUT: StackEntry and InternalStackEntry types from P1.M2.T1.S3.
3. LOGIC: Create src/types/context.ts. Export interface FormStackState with stack: readonly StackEntry[] (public, readonly view). Export interface FormStackActions with openForm<T>(options: OpenFormOptions<T>): Promise<T | undefined>, closeForm(): void.
4. OUTPUT: Context type definitions implementing dual-context pattern for performance.

subtasks.title: Define reducer action types
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - Reducer pattern with actions: PUSH_FORM (entry: InternalStackEntry), POP_FORM, POP_TO_INDEX (index: number).
2. INPUT: InternalStackEntry type from P1.M2.T1.S3.
3. LOGIC: In src/types/context.ts, export type FormStackAction = { type: 'PUSH_FORM', entry: InternalStackEntry } | { type: 'POP_FORM' } | { type: 'POP_TO_INDEX', index: number }. Export interface FormStackReducerState with stack: InternalStackEntry[].
4. OUTPUT: Reducer action types enabling immutable state transitions.

milestones.title: Dual Context Implementation
milestones.description: Implement FormStackProvider with dual-context pattern using useReducer for state management.

tasks.title: Implement FormStackReducer
tasks.description: Create reducer function for managing stack state transitions.

subtasks.title: Implement formStackReducer function
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md and plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Reducer pattern with PUSH_FORM (append to stack), POP_FORM (remove last), POP_TO_INDEX (slice to index). Must be immutable.
2. INPUT: FormStackReducerState and FormStackAction types from P1.M2.T2.S2.
3. LOGIC: Create src/context/formStackReducer.ts. Export function formStackReducer(state: FormStackReducerState, action: FormStackAction): FormStackReducerState. Handle 'PUSH_FORM': return { stack: [...state.stack, action.entry] }. Handle 'POP_FORM': return { stack: state.stack.slice(0, -1) }. Handle 'POP_TO_INDEX': return { stack: state.stack.slice(0, action.index + 1) }.
4. OUTPUT: Pure reducer function managing stack state transitions immutably.

tasks.title: Create Dual Context System
tasks.description: Implement FormStackStateContext and FormStackActionsContext following context splitting pattern.

subtasks.title: Create context definitions
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Context Splitting Pattern: separate FormStackStateContext (read-only stack data) from FormStackActionsContext (operations) to minimize re-renders.
2. INPUT: FormStackState and FormStackActions types from P1.M2.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: Create src/context/FormStackContext.ts. Import createContext from React. Export const FormStackStateContext = createContext<FormStackState | null>(null). Export const FormStackActionsContext = createContext<FormStackActions | null>(null).
4. OUTPUT: Dual context definitions separating state from actions.

subtasks.title: Implement FormStackProvider component
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md and plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Use useReducer with formStackReducer. Memoize context values with useMemo. Provide both contexts. Children prop.
2. INPUT: formStackReducer from P1.M3.T1.S1, context definitions from P1.M3.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: Create src/components/FormStackProvider.tsx. Import useReducer, useMemo, createContext. Define component accepting children: ReactNode. Initialize reducer: const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(formStackReducer, { stack: [] }). Implement openForm using createDeferredPromise (to be created). Implement closeForm dispatching POP_FORM. Memoize state value and actions value. Return providers nested.
4. OUTPUT: FormStackProvider component with dual contexts and memoized values.

subtasks.title: Implement createDeferredPromise function
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - createDeferredPromise<T>() returns { promise: Promise<T | undefined>, resolve: (value: T | undefined) => void, reject: (reason?: unknown) => void }. Critical pattern for async openForm API.

3. LOGIC: Create src/utils/createDeferredPromise.ts. Export function createDeferredPromise<T>(): DeferredPromise<T>. Declare let resolve, reject variables. Create new Promise<T | undefined> assigning res/rej to resolve/reject. Return { promise, resolve: resolve!, reject: reject! }.
4. OUTPUT: Utility function creating externally-controlled promises with resolve/reject methods.

tasks.title: Implement useFormStack Hooks

subtasks.title: Implement useFormStackState hook
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:

subtasks.title: Implement useFormStackActions hook

2. INPUT: FormStackActionsContext from P1.M3.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: Create src/hooks/useFormStackActions.ts. Export function useFormStackActions(): FormStackActions. Call useContext(FormStackActionsContext). If null, throw Error('useFormStackActions must be used within FormStackProvider'). Return context.

subtasks.title: Implement useFormStack combined hook

milestones.title: Form Rendering Engine
milestones.description: Implement form stack renderer with hidden container pattern for state preservation.

tasks.title: Implement FormStackRenderer Component
tasks.description: Build component that renders forms from stack with CSS hiding for inactive forms.

subtasks.title: Implement stack rendering with hidden container pattern
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md and plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Hidden Container Pattern: render all forms, hide inactive with style={{ display: isActive ? 'block' : 'none' }}. Preserves parent state.
2. INPUT: useFormStack hook returning stack array. FormStackProvider with reducer state.
3. LOGIC: Update src/components/FormStackProvider.tsx to include rendering logic. Map over internal stack (state.stack). For each entry, render <div key={entry.id} style={{ display: index === state.stack.length - 1 ? 'block' : 'none' }}>. Inside, render <entry.component />. Inject onSubmit/onCancel/onError callbacks.
4. OUTPUT: FormStackProvider rendering all forms with CSS visibility control.

subtasks.title: Inject form callbacks and wire promise resolution
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - onSubmit calls entry.deferred.resolve(value) then dispatch POP_FORM. onCancel calls entry.deferred.resolve(undefined) then dispatch POP_FORM. onError calls entry.deferred.reject.
2. INPUT: InternalStackEntry with deferred from reducer state.
3. LOGIC: In FormStackProvider render loop, create handleSubmit = (value: T) => { entry.deferred.resolve(value); dispatch({ type: 'POP_FORM' }); }. Create handleCancel = () => { entry.deferred.resolve(undefined); dispatch({ type: 'POP_FORM' }); }. Create handleError = (error: unknown) => { entry.deferred.reject(error); }. Pass to form component: onSubmit={handleSubmit}, onCancel={handleCancel}, onError={handleError}.
4. OUTPUT: Callback injection connecting form actions to promise resolution and stack updates.

subtasks.title: Integrate openForm with createDeferredPromise
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/CODEBASE_STATE.md - openForm creates deferred promise, pushes to stack with PUSH_FORM action, returns promise. Key to async API.
2. INPUT: createDeferredPromise utility from P1.M4.T1.S1. FormStackReducer from P1.M3.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In FormStackProvider, implement openForm = <T>(options: OpenFormOptions<T>): Promise<T | undefined> => { const deferred = createDeferredPromise<T>(); dispatch({ type: 'PUSH_FORM', entry: { ...options, deferred } }); return deferred.promise; }.
4. OUTPUT: openForm method returning Promise that resolves when form submits or cancels.

milestones.title: Breadcrumb Navigation
milestones.description: Build breadcrumb component displaying form hierarchy with clickable navigation.

tasks.title: Create Breadcrumbs Component
tasks.description: Display form stack as clickable breadcrumb trail with separators.

subtasks.title: Implement Breadcrumbs display component
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From PRD Section 7 - Breadcrumbs derived from stack. Show nesting depth. Optional navigation. Click pops deeper forms.
2. INPUT: useFormStackState hook returning stack array.
3. LOGIC: Create src/components/Breadcrumbs.tsx. Accept optional onClick prop. Consume useFormStackState to get stack. Map stack to breadcrumb items: each with id/label. Add separators (> / /) between items. Mark last item as active (not clickable). If onClick provided, make breadcrumbs clickable.
4. OUTPUT: Breadcrumbs component displaying form hierarchy read-only.

subtasks.title: Implement breadcrumb navigation with POP_TO_INDEX
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From PRD Section 7 - Clicking breadcrumb pops all deeper forms. All popped forms canceled (no values returned). Use POP_TO_INDEX reducer action.
2. INPUT: Breadcrumbs component from P2.M1.T1.S1. FormStackActions with dispatch access.
3. LOGIC: Modify Breadcrumbs to accept onClick?: (index: number) => void callback. When breadcrumb clicked (except active), call onClick with index. In FormStackProvider, provide handleBreadcrumbClick = (index: number) => { for (let i = state.stack.length - 1; i > index; i--) { state.stack[i].deferred.resolve(undefined); } dispatch({ type: 'POP_TO_INDEX', index }); }. Pass to Breadcrumbs.
4. OUTPUT: Clickable breadcrumbs that navigate up stack and cancel intermediate forms.

tasks.title: Implement Confirmation Dialog
tasks.description: Create confirmation dialog component and integrate with cancel flow.

subtasks.title: Create ConfirmationDialog component
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From PRD Section 8 - If confirmOnCancel true, show confirmation dialog. On confirm: unmount, resolve undefined. On abort: form remains.
2. INPUT: React and basic component patterns.
3. LOGIC: Create src/components/ConfirmationDialog.tsx. Accept props: message: string, onConfirm: () => void, onCancel: () => void. Render modal-like dialog with message text and 'Confirm' / 'Cancel' buttons. Call respective callbacks on button click.
4. OUTPUT: Reusable confirmation dialog component.

subtasks.title: Integrate confirmation with cancel flow
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From PRD Section 8 - confirmOnCancel stored in FormStackItem. Check before canceling. Show dialog if true.
2. INPUT: InternalStackEntry with confirmOnCancel from P1.M2.T1.S3. ConfirmationDialog from P2.M2.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In FormStackProvider, add state for showing confirmation: const [pendingCancel, setPendingCancel] = useState<number | null>(null). Modify handleCancel to check entry.confirmOnCancel. If true, setPendingCancel(index) instead of dispatching POP. Render ConfirmationDialog when pendingCancel !== null. On confirm, call deferred.resolve(undefined) and dispatch POP. On cancel, dismiss dialog.
4. OUTPUT: Confirmation dialog flow preventing accidental form cancellation.

tasks.title: Implement FormErrorBoundary

subtasks.title: Create FormErrorBoundary class component
subtasks.context_scope:

2. INPUT: React Component class and ErrorInfo types.
3. LOGIC: Create src/components/FormErrorBoundary.tsx. Define class FormErrorBoundary extends React.Component<{ children: ReactNode, onError?: (error: Error) => void, fallback?: ReactNode }, { hasError: boolean, error: Error | null }>. Implement static getDerivedStateFromError returning { hasError: true, error }. Implement componentDidCatch calling onError prop. Render error UI (fallback or default).

subtasks.title: Integrate error boundary with form rendering
subtasks.context_scope:

2. INPUT: FormErrorBoundary from P2.M3.T1.S1. FormStackProvider render loop from P1.M5.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In FormStackProvider render loop, wrap each form in <FormErrorBoundary key={entry.id} onError={(error) => { /* handle error */ }}> with fallback UI containing 'Retry' (remount form) and 'Dismiss' (close form) buttons.
4. OUTPUT: Each form individually wrapped in error boundary with recovery options.

milestones.title: URL Sync Plugin
milestones.description: Create optional hook for bidirectional sync between form stack and URL query parameters.

tasks.title: Create useFormStackURLSync Hook
tasks.description: Implement hook syncing stack state to URL query string with throttling.

subtasks.title: Implement stack to URL encoding
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From plan/architecture/REACT_PATTERNS_RESEARCH_2025.md - Throttle updates to 300ms using useDeferredValue. Simple encoding: form IDs joined by commas. Make react-router-dom optional peer dependency.
2. INPUT: Stack state from useFormStackState. Optional useSearchParams from react-router-dom.
3. LOGIC: Create src/hooks/useFormStackURLSync.ts. Accept stack: StackEntry[] and optional syncEnabled: boolean. If not enabled, return early. Try to import useSearchParams from react-router-dom (catch if missing). Use useEffect to watch stack changes. Encode stack: stack.map(e => e.id).join(','). Update URL with setSearchParams({ stack: encoded }). Throttle with useDeferredValue.
4. OUTPUT: Hook that syncs form stack to URL query string when enabled.

subtasks.title: Implement URL to stack restoration
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: From PRD Section 11 - URL reflects current form stack. Back/forward navigation supported. Restore stack on mount.
2. INPUT: Query params from useSearchParams on mount.
3. LOGIC: In useFormStackURLSync, on mount, read searchParams.get('stack'). If exists, decode: encoded.split(',').map(id => ({ id })). Dispatch 'RESTORE_STACK' action or call openForm for each. Handle invalid IDs gracefully (ignore). Only restore on initial mount, not subsequent URL changes.
4. OUTPUT: URL-to-stack restoration on initial load supporting back/forward navigation.
